member.summary: Takes the exclusive owner claim for , from the thread that constructed this slot and no other.
member.remarks: This is the check that makes "the thread that created the ConfigModule" the Simulation Owner Thread for everything downstream: WorldConfigBinding claims here in its constructor, so a binding can only be built on that thread, and the manager it is handed to inherits the same thread.
